n: Anthropic AI Fluency for PK-12 Educators
t: A free online course that teaches educators a four-part framework for working with AI.
steps: Find the course on Anthropic Academy, which runs on the Skilljar platform. It is also listed on Coursera.
Create a learner account with a work email address.
Enroll in AI Fluency for PK-12 Educators, which is course 1 of 2.
Work through the modules on a school laptop or personal device.
Write down one classroom task for each of the four Ds.
Share the framework with colleagues at a staff meeting.
Look at the Train the Trainer course if your school wants to lead its own sessions.
